decision: Choose one of up to 8 fully constructed, distinct Replace children; candidate 0 is the exact Balanced child
candidate_generation: Same legal target and repair executor as the current Balanced branch; deterministic private seeds; no objective evaluation before selection

prediction.parent_q90_objectives_at_mutation: usually unavailable after crossover; never used as inference input
prediction.candidate_input: constructed child and current population available before objective evaluation
prediction.selection: maximize exact 3D HV calculation on predicted objectives and current feasible population using frozen normalization and reference; tie or unsupported state selects Balanced
prediction.guarantee: Balanced inclusion is an abstention option, not a guaranteed HV floor

historical_data: ordinary mutation logs do not contain complete evaluated child encodings; the 384-state five-operator audit is not an eight-child offline test set

collection.additional_objective_evaluations: count every extra candidate evaluation separately from search budget
collection.split_unit: instance, with all candidates from a state kept together
collection.preprocessing: fit objective and feature scales on training instances only

offline_screen.data: new matched K8 panel; the old five-operator panel is exploratory only
offline_screen.primary_metric: mean actual selected-child HV contribution minus exact Balanced-child contribution over all held-out states
offline_screen.pass: mean gain positive, each validation instance positive, and at least one non-Balanced child chosen; do not adjust this rule on validation outcomes

development_search.checkpoint_selection: validation instances only; no development or final-test selection

ppo.admission: one frozen supervised model first completes the paired development search
ppo.reward: selected evaluated child's actual normalized population HV contribution
ppo.qualification: immediate reward does not guarantee final population HV gain; compare with the same pretrained checkpoint

development_gate: predeclared paired mean final-HV difference versus Balanced positive on each development instance; report all ten seeds and no retry with revised threshold

final_test.source_catalog: original instance catalog with test-side OD pool
final_test.rule: Freeze one model and all baselines before opening final-test outputs; evaluate each method once on the same instances, seeds and scenarios

prior_profile_screen.interpretation: Fixed Emission is a promising rule; instance-specific best is posthoc and offers a small, unconfirmed additional gain. The completed screen remains failed.
